answers.rationale: The requirement specifies the manufacture of complete metal-clad switchgear for continuous service, which aligns with the description of the CROWN-ARMV product in the catalog as it is the default for metal-clad switchgear lines.

Erecting the equipment enclosure and ensuring it is level and anchored is part of the installation process for the CROWN-ARMV switchgear.
The requirement to avoid roof penetrations is a design consideration for the CROWN-ARMV switchgear enclosures.
